theme_and_archetype.theme: LIGHT (Default) with High-Contrast DARK mode option
theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) mixed with Industrial/Safety aesthetics
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The current dashboard is too dark and unreadable. We are migrating to a default Light theme with high-contrast borders and typography, prioritizing data legibility (Control Room Grid). The dark mode is adjusted to a lighter slate background to resolve the 'too dark' complaint.

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50
hierarchy_rules.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy_rules.small_labels: text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.05em] uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

css_variables_strategy.instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace existing hardcoded hex colors in index.css with CSS variables (e.g. --background, --foreground, etc.) mapping to the provided HSL values. 2. Remove scattered inline hex colors (like bg-[#19243C]) across all 100+ components and replace them with standard Tailwind semantic classes (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, border-border). 3. Use 'dark' class on HTML or body to toggle modes. The dark mode must be lighter than previous (#0F172A instead of #0B1120) to ensure readability.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tight and dense for data visibility. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard panels.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: max 8px (rounded-md) across the app to maintain an industrial/professional aesthetic.

card.style: Flat, 1px subtle border, no heavy shadows. Background should match 'card' variable.
card.tailwind_classes: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border rounded-md shadow-sm
card.hover_state: None needed for static cards. Interactive cards can use hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800.

table.style: Dense and highly readable. Zebra striping for rows.
table.header_classes: bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/50 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs px-4 py-3 border-b border-border
table.row_classes: border-b border-border hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors even:bg-slate-50/50 dark:even:bg-slate-800/20

button.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2
button.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors border border-border

input.style: Clear boundaries, good contrast for forms.
input.tailwind_classes: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

dialog.content: fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-lg translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 border border-border bg-background p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 sm:rounded-lg

icon_strategy.usage: Use consistent stroke width (2px) and sizes (16px for inline text, 24px for navigation/buttons).

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements must include data-testid. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text). The primary green (#166534) against white passes with 5.6:1 contrast ratio.
